source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 4 ("Rural councils (continued from page 10): Dungannon")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'For the 19 electoral divisions 12 Unionists and five Nationalists have been returned unopposed'; 'New members are W. M. Buchanan ... who replaces Mr. Thomas Curry' (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 4)

note: Triennial election of the 19 electoral divisions of Dungannon rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twelve Unionists and five Nationalists were returned unopposed; Crossdernott and Coalisland were contested. The new council had thirteen Unionists and six Nationalists, with three members to be co-opted. Division inferred from the 3 October 1946 return (Clonaneese: T. Curry, whom he replaces); the Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 4 names him as returned. He sat for Clonaneese in 1964 and 1967. The record previously filed him under an Aughnacloy division, which Dungannon rural district does not have. Returned unopposed.
